title: 🇵🇹 Clo Social Porto
description:
Revive os melhores momentos do nosso CLO Social Porto - o nosso primerio evento de networking em Portugal! Queremos deixar um sincero agradecimiento à nossa comunidade de utilizadores e às novas caras em Portugal. Que vieram partilhar as suas experiências com o CLO e a sua jornada de transformação 3D. Um grande obrigado a todos os que estiveram presentes!

------

Enjoy the highlights from our CLO Social Porto – our first-ever networking event in Portugal! We extend a heartfelt thank you to our existing user base and new faces in Portugal who came to share their experiences with CLO and their 3D transformation journey. Thank you to everyone who attended!

Sign up for our newsletter to stay up-to-date on more events across Europe, news, and updates! 👉 http://eepurl.com/hLgyyz 

Questions? Join our CLO Community on CONNECT 👉 https://connect.clo-set.com/community

summary: # CLOU Event in Portugal ## Introduction Hello everyone, and welcome to the first CLOU event in Portugal. This is the first event that we are hosting in Porto, but it will not be the last. ## Innovation in the Text Area The main idea behind this event is to foster innovation in the text area. The big advantage and beauty of 3D technology lie in the data it provides. ## Objectives The aim of this event is essentially to fit photos and post prints. We are working with a significant quantity of data—5 million entries to be precise. ## Localization and Adaptation We are focusing on the localization of cards and cassettes, adapting several options to meet diverse needs. ## The Role of Digital Technology At the end of the day, digital technology will allow us to prototype, reduce risks, and accelerate results. ## Conclusion And that's it! That’s how we transition from vision to reality. Thank you very much.
